{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索南汀渡口记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"午后青篙听到传言，以为铜钥匙仍在茶摊；桥匠已经知道钥匙在自己的工具箱里。桥匠依照交接记录检查工具箱，发现铜钥匙；他没有把消息告诉青篙。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-PPDG","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A18f01784-6b95-4b2b-92d6-3d3a77ab1be1:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:18f01784-6b95-4b2b-92d6-3d3a77ab1be1"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["午后青篙听到传言，以为铜钥匙仍在茶摊；桥匠已经知道钥匙在自己的工具箱里。桥匠依照交接记录检查工具箱，发现铜钥匙；他没有把消息告诉青篙。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"茶摊老板数清十二只瓷杯，另买一袋茶叶；这件事不使用东闸或铜钥匙。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-PPDG","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A19b9f0eb-a351-4728-9eeb-d1574b7e091e:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:19b9f0eb-a351-4728-9eeb-d1574b7e091e"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["茶摊老板数清十二只瓷杯，另买一袋茶叶；这件事不使用东闸或铜钥匙。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"初三清晨，渡工沈青把铜钥匙交给修桥者沈青，两人是不同的人。渡口规约写明：东闸只能用铜钥匙开启。河面映着一条淡金色的光带。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-PPDG","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ae9aef452-4ea5-4e67-bae6-fcc5656d7e39:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:e9aef452-4ea5-4e67-bae6-fcc5656d7e39"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["初三清晨，渡工沈青把铜钥匙交给修桥者沈青，两人是不同的人。渡口规约写明：东闸只能用铜钥匙开启。河面映着一条淡金色的光带。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"傍晚桥匠用工具箱里的铜钥匙开启东闸，完成护送承诺；青篙仍按午后听来的传言去茶摊寻找。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-PPDG","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Af15b527e-d5e5-4b3f-ba10-2e3aab5940b1:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:f15b527e-d5e5-4b3f-ba10-2e3aab5940b1"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["傍晚桥匠用工具箱里的铜钥匙开启东闸，完成护送承诺；青篙仍按午后听来的传言去茶摊寻找。"]}]}
